name: FullEnrich
description: People and company search, profile lookups, firmographics, and verified contact data.

tools.name: Company lookup
tools.description: Resolve one company from its domain, LinkedIn company URL, or LinkedIn company ID. Returns firmographics, technologies, social profiles, and locations.

options.name: domain
options.about: Company domain, such as fullenrich.com.

options.name: professional_network_url
options.about: LinkedIn company URL.

options.name: professional_network_id
options.about: LinkedIn company ID.

response.about: The best matching company in the companies array, or an empty array when no match is found. No-match costs no credits.

tools.name: Company match
tools.description: Match an exact LinkedIn company URL. Use companies/lookup to resolve a domain, or companies/search to build a shortlist.

options.name: linkedin_url
options.about: Canonical LinkedIn company URL, such as https://www.linkedin.com/company/fullenrich. Matched exactly.

response.about: At most one matching company in the companies array. An empty array costs no credits.

tools.name: Company search

tools.name: Mobile number
tools.description: Find a person's mobile phone number from a LinkedIn URL, or from their name and employer. The most expensive line by far: ask for it only when a phone is what the task needs. To enrich multiple contacts, send up to 10 separate calls in the Firecrawl /v2/scrape alexandria array, each with its own provider, capability and options. Each call accepts one contact, runs as a separate upstream job and is billed only for a result found. Inspect each call for errors; this is not a single bulk job. Concurrent enrichments share poll capacity and can hit rate limits; spread large batches out. Do not pass a contacts array in options.

options.name: first_name
options.about: Given name. With last_name and a company, an alternative to linkedin_url.

options.name: last_name
options.about: Family name.

options.name: domain
options.about: Employer domain, such as fullenrich.com. Either this or company_name identifies the company.

options.name: company_name
options.about: Employer name, when the domain is not known.

options.name: linkedin_url
options.about: LinkedIn profile URL, standard or Sales Navigator. Enough on its own, improves match rates when added to a name, and returns the professional profile alongside the contact data.

response.about: One record in results when a mobile number was found, an empty array when not. An empty array costs nothing. contact_info carries most_probable_phone and the phones candidates; profile is present when linkedin_url was given.

fields.name: input
fields.about: The identifiers the enrichment ran on, as FullEnrich echoes them.

fields.name: profile
fields.about: Professional profile, when linkedin_url was given. Same shape as people/lookup records.

tools.name: Reverse email lookup
tools.description: Identify the person and company behind a work or personal email address. Returns a professional profile; use people/lookup when a name or LinkedIn URL is already known. To enrich multiple contacts, send up to 10 separate calls in the Firecrawl /v2/scrape alexandria array, each with its own provider, capability and options. Each call accepts one contact, runs as a separate upstream job and is billed only for a result found. Inspect each call for errors; this is not a single bulk job. Concurrent enrichments share poll capacity and can hit rate limits; spread large batches out. Do not pass a contacts array in options.

options.name: email
options.about: The work or personal email address to identify.

response.about: One record in results when the person behind the email was found, an empty array when not. An empty array costs nothing. profile carries the person and their employer.

fields.name: input
fields.about: The email the lookup ran on, as FullEnrich echoes it.

fields.name: profile
fields.about: Professional profile with current employer. Fields: id, full_name, first_name, last_name, headline, description, location, social_profiles, employment, educations, languages, skills.
